name: A Terrible Purpose
label: Quest
description: A Terrible Purpose: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ok, here we are... A pretty valuable chunk of information, I must say! I've seen the Cenarion Circle forces arrive at Silithus. They plan to drive the Twilight's Hammer out, don't they? This will help.
Take this parchment to their leader, Commander Mar'alith. Soon the Twilight's Hammer will be vanquished and I will be outside their grasp for good!

clips.title: Progress
paras: What is this you bring to me, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is very interesting information indeed, friend. This sheds some light on the presence of the Twilight's Hammer in Silithus and will undoubtedly help us in our struggle against them. Your efforts will be handsomely rewarded, adventurer.
